appliances.name: Refrigerator
appliances.efficiency_tip: Set temperature to 37°F (3°C) for fridge and 0°F (-18°C) for freezer. Keep coils dust-free.

appliances.name: Air Conditioner
appliances.efficiency_tip: Set thermostat to 24–26°C. Use ceiling fans alongside AC to spread cool air.

appliances.name: Water Heater (Electric)
appliances.efficiency_tip: Set water heater to 49°C. Insulate the tank and pipes. Use a timer to heat only during off-peak hours.

appliances.name: Washing Machine
appliances.efficiency_tip: Wash clothes in cold water. Run full loads only. Use the high-spin setting to reduce drying time.

appliances.name: Clothes Dryer
appliances.efficiency_tip: Clean the lint filter after every use. Air-dry when possible.

appliances.name: Dishwasher
appliances.efficiency_tip: Run full loads only. Use air-dry instead of heat-dry mode.

appliances.name: Electric Oven
appliances.efficiency_tip: Avoid preheating for long periods. Use a microwave for small meals.

appliances.name: Microwave Oven
appliances.efficiency_tip: Prefer microwave over oven for reheating — it uses 80% less energy.

appliances.name: Television (LED 55in)
appliances.efficiency_tip: Enable auto-brightness. Turn off rather than leaving on standby.

appliances.name: Desktop Computer
appliances.efficiency_tip: Enable sleep mode after 10 minutes of inactivity. Use a laptop which uses 80% less power.

appliances.name: Laptop
appliances.efficiency_tip: Lower screen brightness. Unplug charger when fully charged.

appliances.name: LED Bulb (10W)
appliances.efficiency_tip: Use motion sensors or timers. Replace any remaining incandescent bulbs.

appliances.name: Incandescent Bulb (60W)
appliances.efficiency_tip: Replace with LED equivalents immediately — they use 85% less energy.

appliances.name: Ceiling Fan
appliances.efficiency_tip: Turn off fans when leaving the room. Use anti-clockwise in summer for cooling effect.

appliances.name: Electric Iron
appliances.efficiency_tip: Iron in one session per week rather than daily small sessions.

appliances.name: Water Pump
appliances.efficiency_tip: Run pump during off-peak hours. Fix leaky pipes to reduce pumping frequency.

appliances.name: EV Charger (Level 2)
appliances.efficiency_tip: Charge during off-peak night hours to save on time-of-use tariffs.

appliances.name: Space Heater
appliances.efficiency_tip: Use only in occupied rooms. Keep the room well-insulated.

appliances.name: Pool Pump
appliances.efficiency_tip: Use a variable-speed pump and run during off-peak hours.

appliances.name: Gaming Console
appliances.efficiency_tip: Enable energy-saving mode. Turn off instead of using rest/standby mode.
